evidence_items.explanation: The January–June research reports limited sustained productivity or profit impact from enterprise implementations. Its interview-based estimates, varying samples, and differing success definitions limit generalization to all businesses.

evidence_items.publisher: Bloomberg News, republished by Insurance Journal
evidence_items.explanation: Bain's survey of 951 companies documents savings below expectations. It covers automation and AI more broadly, and neither this bucket nor a missed target establishes that most generative-AI deployments produced small gains.

evidence_items.locator: Findings list following 'According to the 2025 report'
evidence_items.explanation: This institutional summary describes a generative-AI survey of more than 800 senior leaders at large US companies. It challenges a blanket no-return reading, but self-reported positive returns do not establish large gains or a population-wide aggregate.
